audio_description:
Squall, cradling Rinoa, drifts through space beside a small pod.
Ahead, a dark winged vessel hangs silhouetted against the moon.

context.scene_title: Squall and Rinoa drift through space toward a derelict vessel (Disc 3, leading to the Ragnarok).
locations: Open space near the moon, with a darkened vessel ahead

characters.name: Squall Leonhart
characters.recognition: Brown-haired, face visible in his helmet, holding Rinoa as they drift beside a piece of machinery/escape pod.

characters.name: Rinoa Heartilly
characters.recognition: Held in Squall's arms in her spacesuit.

context.summary: Squall, cradling Rinoa, drifts through space beside a small craft/pod; ahead, a dark winged vessel hangs silhouetted against the moon — the derelict ship they make for after the rescue.
context.context_note: High confidence on Squall and Rinoa adrift; the dark vessel ahead is read as the derelict ship (the Ragnarok), which the next clips confirm.
